cc:Work.dc:title: Conformance
cc:Work.dc:description: Three separately denominated scopes: exact frontend agreement, reaching 3174 of 3174 on the new P66 TypeScript target; independently specified runtime semantics on 96 scenarios; and the expanded P66 JavaScript census across 1170 eligible rows. The census records 1045 golden passes, 123 exemptions, 1 shared failure and 1 deferred row, with zero TypeScript-pass / Bend-fail cases. TypeScript has 1044 golden passes. These scopes do not form one percentage.

g.text: P66: 3,174 / 3,174 observations · new upstream target · axis starts at 70%
Same 96 source-oracle scenarios · each compiler image tested separately
Latest P66: B1 and B2 pass 96/96 each · TypeScript 95/96
P66 · 1,170 eligible fixture rows · zero TS-pass / Bend-fail cases
1,045 golden passes include 54 supplemental Bun passes; TypeScript has 1,044.
Exempt, failed and deferred rows are not counted as passes. B2 remains separately qualified.
